sourceChecks.scope: Free primary descriptive dissertation on -te-, argues for several entangled functions and notes contested analyses. Supports the limited retrospective/firsthand perception characterization for -더-; it cautions against reducing the marker to a single past/evidential meaning. It does not establish every terminal construction (-더라고요, -던데요) or the article’s generalizations/examples.

Fuente consultada: Viewpoints in the Korean Verbal Complex: Evidence, Perception, Assessment, and Time; localizador: Chapter 3 §3.2.1.4 “The Retrospective Firsthand Evidential Marker -Te-,” printed pp.70–76 (PDF pp.89–95), especially subheadings 3.2.1.4.1–3 and examples (51)–(64); see also Chapter 4 §5.4.1 for discourse contexts. Alcance comprobado y límites: Free primary descriptive dissertation on -te-, argues for several entangled functions and notes contested analyses. Supports the limited retrospective/firsthand perception characterization for -더-; it cautions against reducing the marker to a single past/evidential meaning. It does not establish every terminal construction (-더라고요, -던데요) or the article’s generalizations/examples.
